baseline: Original entries and gates; TP1=1.2R TP2=2R; passive-limit-v3

hypotheses.target_3r: Only extend TP2 to 3R; retain entry, stop, TP1 and original trailing
hypotheses.half_structural_buffer: Halve only the margin outside the existing structure; retain entry and price targets; normalize fee R inversely to stop distance
hypotheses.spread_risk_cap: Reject when stressed modeled spread exceeds 25% of stop distance; no alternative entries

selection_rule: Report every declared variant; do not optimize parameters after results; no winner or promotion from a four-trade reference
isolation_reason: Live workspace engine/orb/config/replay changed concurrently; restart same predeclared hypotheses against archived baseline source copies; old partial runs excluded.
